newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Truck crashes in front of Brazil school, two dead.
newsitem.headline: Truck crashes in front of Brazil school, two dead.

text.p: Two children were killed and four injured when a truck carrying bottled cooking gas crashed in front of a school in the city of Manaus in Brazil's Amazon region, police said on Tuesday.

The truck was going the wrong way down the street in front of the Cristo Redentor school as children were leaving to go home, a police spokesman said. It crashed and hit the school wall but did not explode, he added.
A 12-year-old boy and 10-year-old girl were killed.
